d:
Step into the world of legendary Bengali author Bibhutibhushan Bandopadhyay! Join me as I explore Gaurikunj, Ghatshila, the historic residence of the iconic writer behind Pather Panchali. Nestled in the scenic beauty of Jharkhand, this former home is now a museum filled with rare manuscripts, personal belongings, and photographs, offering a fascinating glimpse into his literary journey.
